name: Captain Widgets Kit for Elementor
author: Dipak Dodiya

sections.description:
Captain Widgets Kit is a free Elementor addon that adds powerful widgets, WooCommerce widgets, display conditions, dynamic tags, and WordPress tools to your website. Everything can be managed from a clean, modern React-based admin dashboard.

Whether you’re building a WooCommerce store, portfolio, blog, or business website, Captain Widgets Kit provides a flexible collection of tools to help you build and customize your website with Elementor.

🔢 What’s Included at a Glance:

  • 🧩 30 Elementor Widgets : Buttons, headings, galleries, countdowns, tabs, mega menus, listings, and more
  • 🛒 27 WooCommerce Widgets : Product pages, shop pages, cart, checkout, account, and product utility widgets
  • 🔌 11 Elementor Extensions : Display conditions, custom CSS, custom JavaScript, and wrapper links
  • ⚙️ 3 WordPress Extensions : Duplicate posts, disable Gutenberg, and disable Elementor icons
  • 🏷️ Dynamic Tags : Post, author, site, user, archive, taxonomy, WooCommerce, and ACF / SCF data
  • 71+ Features : A complete collection of Elementor widgets, extensions, dynamic tags, and WordPress tools

🧩 Elementor Widgets (30)

Enable or disable individual widgets from the admin panel. All widgets are free.

  • Button : Advanced button with icon, link, hover effects, and full styling controls
  • Dual Button : Display two buttons side by side with independent styling and icon controls
  • Heading Title : Advanced heading with optional highlight phrase, subtitle, separator, and link
  • Text Block : Rich text block with advanced typography and styling controls
  • Separator : Decorative divider with multiple styles, icons, and gradient support
  • Star Rating : Flexible star or icon rating with fractional support, custom icons, and labels
  • Blockquote : Stylish quote widget with author name, avatar, and attribution
  • Countdown : Countdown timer with target date and time settings and multiple display styles
  • Pricing Box : Feature-rich pricing box with icons, feature lists, and call-to-action options
  • Tabs : Tabbed content widget with smooth transitions, icons, and styling controls
  • Testimonial : Customer testimonial with avatar, star rating, author information, and styling options
  • Animated Box : Animated content box with front and back sides and hover effects
  • Animated Marquee : Smooth scrolling text or logo marquee with speed and styling controls
  • Age Gate : Age verification gate to restrict access to page content
  • Cookie Consent : Cookie consent banner with accept and decline actions
  • Mega Menu : Advanced navigation menu with multi-column layout support
  • Progress Bar : Animated progress bar with labels, percentages, and styling controls
  • Scroll Navigation Dots : Sticky dot navigation for full-page scrolling sections
  • Search Bar : AJAX-powered search bar with live results and custom post type support
  • Search Filter : Advanced post filter with taxonomy, meta, and keyword filtering
  • Side Menu : Sliding off-canvas side menu with overlay, close button, and styling options
  • Table : Responsive data table with multiple style presets and sortable columns
  • Grid Listing : Post and custom post type grid with filters, pagination, and flexible layouts
  • Gallery Listing : Image gallery with lightbox, filtering, and masonry layout support
  • Site Logo : Responsive site logo with custom width, link, and inline SVG support
  • Social Icons : Customizable social media icon links with hover effects and styling controls
  • Post Title : Display post or page titles with typography and link controls
  • Post Content : Dynamically render post content inside Elementor templates
  • Post Author : Display post author information with avatar, bio, and social links
  • Post Comments : Display the WordPress comments section with customizable styling

🛒 WooCommerce Widgets (27)

Build complete WooCommerce product pages, shop pages, and account areas with Elementor. Requires WooCommerce.

Product Page Widgets:

  • Product Title : Display product titles with typography and heading tag controls
  • Product Price : Display regular, sale, and variable product prices with styling controls
  • Product Description : Display the full WooCommerce product description with custom typography
  • Product Excerpt : Display the short product description with flexible styling options
  • Product Rating : Display product star ratings with count, custom icons, and layout controls
  • Product Meta : Display SKU, categories, tags, and custom product metadata with label styling
  • Product Add to Cart : Customizable add to cart button with quantity selector and styling controls
  • Product Gallery : Display product images with thumbnails, slider, and lightbox-ready controls
  • Product Image : Display the featured product image with custom size, link, and hover styling
  • Product Tab : Display WooCommerce product tabs including Description, Reviews, and Additional Information
  • Product Notice : Display WooCommerce notices and alerts with custom styling
  • Sales Badge : Display sale, new, featured, and custom product badges with flexible positioning
  • Product Stock : Display product stock status and quantity with custom labels
  • Product SKU : Display product SKU with prefix, fallback text, and inline or pill layouts

Shop & Archive Widgets:

  • Product Categories : Display WooCommerce categories in a customizable grid layout
  • Product Filter : Filter products by price, rating, and attributes using WooCommerce query parameters
  • Related Products : Display related WooCommerce products in a customizable grid
  • Upsell Products : Showcase assigned upsell products with flexible layout and styling controls
  • Compare Table : Display WooCommerce products side by side in a customizable comparison table

Cart & Checkout Widgets:

  • Mini Cart : Display a live mini cart with item count, subtotal, drawer support, and cart fragment refresh
  • Cart Page : Display a complete WooCommerce cart layout with items, totals, and checkout button
  • Checkout Page : Display a complete WooCommerce checkout form with billing, shipping, and order summary

Account & Authentication Widgets:

  • Account Page : Build a customizable WooCommerce My Account page with custom tabs and styling options
  • Login / Register : Display customizable WooCommerce login and registration forms

Product Utility Widgets:

  • Breadcrumb : Display WooCommerce breadcrumb navigation with custom separators and styling options
  • Wishlist Button : Add a customizable wishlist toggle with custom icons and active states
  • Product Breadcrumbs : Display a category-aware breadcrumb trail for WooCommerce product pages

🔌 Elementor Extensions (11)

Add powerful display conditions and useful enhancements to any Elementor section, column, or widget.

  • Device Type : Show or hide elements based on the visitor’s device, including mobile, tablet, or desktop
  • Operating System : Control visibility based on the visitor’s operating system, including Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, or Linux
  • Browser Compatibility : Show or hide content based on the visitor’s browser, including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge
  • Geo Location : Control content visibility based on the visitor’s country or region
  • URL Conditions : Show or hide elements based on URL parameters or query strings
  • Page Conditions : Target specific pages, post types, or Elementor templates
  • Date & Time Visibility : Schedule elements to appear or hide during specific dates and times
  • Weekdays Visibility : Display content only on selected days of the week
  • Custom CSS : Add custom CSS directly to individual Elementor widgets
  • Custom JavaScript : Add custom JavaScript directly to individual Elementor widgets
  • Wrapper Link : Make any Elementor widget or section fully clickable with a custom link

⚙️ WordPress Extensions (3)

Add useful tools to improve your WordPress editing workflow and site performance.

  • Duplicate Post Type : Quickly duplicate posts, pages, and custom post types directly from the WordPress admin list
  • Disable Gutenberg : Disable the block editor and use the classic WordPress editor instead
  • Disable Elementor Icons : Disable unused Elementor icon font sets to help reduce unnecessary assets

🏷️ Dynamic Tags

Dynamically populate Elementor text, image, URL, and media fields with real-time data from your WordPress site.

  • Post Tags : Post title, content, excerpt, ID, date, time, slug, status, post type, terms, tags, categories, and featured image
  • Author Tags : Author name, URL, avatar, and author information
  • Site Tags : Site title, tagline, URL, current date/time, site icon, and site logo
  • User Tags : User information, user meta, login/logout URL, and avatar
  • Archive Tags : Archive title, description, URL, metadata, and featured image
  • Taxonomy Tags : Term title, description, URL, count, and term image
  • WooCommerce Tags : Product title, price, short description, description, rating, SKU, stock status, stock quantity, sale status, gallery, shipping, attributes, purchase note, product type, category, and tags. Requires WooCommerce.
  • ACF / SCF Tags : Text, image, URL, and gallery fields from ACF or SCF. Requires Advanced Custom Fields or Secure Custom Fields.

🎛️ Admin Dashboard

Manage all widgets, extensions, and dynamic tags from a clean, modern React-powered admin dashboard.

  • Feature Controls : Enable or disable individual widgets, extensions, and tools without touching code
  • Dark Mode : Enjoy a consistent dark mode experience across the dashboard
  • Feature Search : Quickly find widgets and extensions using the built-in filter and search options
  • Organized Management : Dedicated sections for Elementor Widgets, WooCommerce Widgets, Elementor Extensions, Dynamic Tags, and WordPress Extensions
  • Version Rollback : Roll back to any of the last 10 plugin releases directly from the dashboard
  • Onboarding Flow : Guided onboarding experience for new users

Why Choose Captain Widgets Kit?

✅ 100% Free : No upsells, no locked features, no credit card required
✅ 71+ Features : Widgets, extensions, dynamic tags all in one plugin
✅ WooCommerce Ready : 27 dedicated WooCommerce widgets for complete store building
✅ Performance Focused : Enable only what you use; disable everything else
✅ Display Conditions : 8 powerful conditions to control element visibility
✅ Dynamic Tags : Works with free Elementor ( No Pro Required )
✅ Clean Dashboard : React-based UI with dark mode and filter search
✅ ACF / SCF Support : Pull custom field data into any Elementor field
✅ PHP 8.0–8.4 Compatible : Built for modern WordPress hosting environments
✅ WordPress Coding Standards : Clean, maintainable, well-documented code

🌟 OUR PRODUCTS:

🥇 Captain Feed for YouTube : Display YouTube videos, channels, playlists, and live streams on your WordPress website with flexible layouts and customization options.

🥇 Captain Social Review : Display reviews and testimonials from multiple platforms with beautiful layouts, filtering options, and easy customization.

🥇 Captain Advance Filter : Add powerful AJAX filters to WooCommerce and WordPress websites with flexible filtering options, search, pagination, and easy customization.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the captain-widgets-kit folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Go to Captain Widgets Kit from the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Enable or disable individual widgets, extensions, and features based on your requirements.
  5. Open the Elementor editor and find Captain Widgets Kit widgets in their dedicated widget category.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Captain Widgets Kit requires the free version of Elementor to be installed and active.

Are all widgets free?

Yes. All currently available widgets, extensions, dynamic tags, and WordPress tools are completely free.

Does the Dynamic Tags feature require Elementor Pro?

No. Dynamic Tags work with the free version of Elementor and do not require an Elementor Pro subscription.

Is WooCommerce required for all features?

No. WooCommerce is only required for the WooCommerce widgets and WooCommerce dynamic tags. All other features work without WooCommerce.

Is ACF required for Dynamic Tags?

ACF (Advanced Custom Fields) or SCF (Secure Custom Fields) is only required for the ACF / SCF Dynamic Tags. All other Dynamic Tags work without these plugins.

Can I enable only the widgets I need?

Yes. The admin dashboard lets you enable or disable individual widgets, extensions, and features based on your requirements.

Is this compatible with Elementor Free?

Yes. Captain Widgets Kit is designed to work with the free version of Elementor, including its Dynamic Tags functionality.

What PHP version is required?

Captain Widgets Kit requires PHP 7.4 or higher.
